message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-04 with raw ADC sampling rate control: RATE? query and RATE<hz>/SR<hz>/HZ<hz> commands, 1-500 Hz accepted with integer-ms interval readback, app UART on P0.25/P0.26, Green/IR/Red LED pins P0.11/P0.12/P0.13, DAC A/B bias amp commands, active single ADC streaming with selectable ADC3/ADC2/ADC0 input, PPG ambient-subtracted phase sampling, single-source 9999 bitmap support, residual/delta TRNG mixing, Von Neumann extraction, and UART DFU bootloader entry.
